chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.568: Li Huowang's Meltdown Over Zhuge Yuan's Death
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang shatters under the weight of grief when Yi Donglai forces him to confront Zhuge Yuan's death. A raw, emotional breakdown that questions the cost of caring in the Dao-Twisted World.
og_description: Li Huowang breaks completely. Yi Donglai forces him to face the one truth he cannot run from: Zhuge Yuan is gone.
twitter_description: A fast-food breakfast turns into a screaming breakdown. The modern hospital becomes the stage for the novel's most visceral emotional collapse.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese political geomancy, the dragon vein is the underground energy channel that determines a dynasty's legitimacy. Tampering with or cutting it can rewrite history.
In traditional Chinese folklore, wells are often seen as portals between the mortal world and the underworld; waking at the bottom of one is a powerful symbol of descent and rebirth.
A physical restraint device used in psychiatric hospitals; in this novel, its application is a literal and symbolic act of binding the protagonist to his suffering.

The psychiatrist in Li Huowang's modern-world hallucination; he uses rational language and emotional manipulation to force Li Huowang back to the Dao-Twisted World, functioning as a metaphysical antagonist.
